questions.text: In "Toy Story", what kind of toy is Woody?
questions.explanation: Woody is a pull-string cowboy doll.

questions.text: In "Shrek", what kind of creature is the title character?
questions.explanation: Shrek is a green ogre living in a swamp.

questions.text: Which wizarding school does Harry Potter attend?
questions.explanation: Harry studies at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.

questions.text: In "The Empire Strikes Back", who reveals he is Luke Skywalker's father?
questions.explanation: Vader tells Luke "I am your father".

questions.text: Which action franchise features the line "I'll be back"?
questions.explanation: Arnold Schwarzenegger's Terminator delivers the line.

questions.text: Which actor played Indiana Jones in the original trilogy?
In Peter Jackson's "Lord of the Rings" films, who plays Gandalf?
questions.explanation: Ian McKellen played Gandalf the Grey and the White.

questions.text: What is the name of the fictional African nation in 2018's "Black Panther"?
questions.explanation: Wakanda is the home of T'Challa.

questions.text: Which 1975 Steven Spielberg film is often credited with starting the summer blockbuster?
answers: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
questions.explanation: Jaws opened wide in June 1975 and broke box-office records.

questions.text: In "The Matrix", which colour pill does Neo take to learn the truth?
questions.explanation: Neo takes the red pill offered by Morpheus.

questions.text: Which director made the "Dollars Trilogy" starring Clint Eastwood?
questions.explanation: Leone directed A Fistful of Dollars and its two sequels.

questions.text: What is the name of the spaceship in the original "Alien" (1979)?
questions.explanation: Ripley and her crew serve aboard the commercial towing vessel Nostromo.

questions.text: Which actor played the young Vito Corleone in "The Godfather Part II"?
questions.explanation: De Niro won an Oscar for the role.

questions.text: Which 1982 Ridley Scott film is based on a Philip K. Dick novel?
questions.explanation: Blade Runner adapts "Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?".

questions.text: Which composer wrote the shrieking-strings score for Hitchcock's "Psycho"?
questions.explanation: Herrmann composed the famous Psycho score in 1960.

spares.text: Which Disney film features the song "Let It Go"?
spares.explanation: "Let It Go" is sung by Elsa in Frozen.

spares.text: Which actor plays Captain Jack Sparrow in "Pirates of the Caribbean"?
spares.explanation: Depp played Sparrow throughout the original films.

spares.text: Which director made "Apocalypse Now" (1979), inspired by "Heart of Darkness"?
spares.explanation: Coppola transposed Conrad's story to the Vietnam War.
